race.comment: SEVEN DAYS (4) is ready to win after finishing runner-up at her two runs this time in at Hawkesbury. Jumped in class with an eye-catching second from back in the field over this trip at Hawkesbury in BM64 class. Can swoop over the top of these. COSMIC ORDER (8) comes here with a fitness edge fifth-up after sitting on the speed to run fourth over 1000m at Gosford on the heavy track. Claim helps on the good track and expected to take a hand in the finish. BIG LON (9) improving gelding who deserves his chance here after scoring a solid Maiden win at Tamworth. Respect from the inside barrier. EXPIDO (2) bled when a dominant fav last time in. Might need the run but has shown glimpses of genuine ability. Keeping safe.
